definitions.explanation: Large waves on the ocean, especially those caused by wind. A formal or technical term commonly used in weather reports and maritime contexts.

examples.japanese: {波浪警報|はろうけいほう}が{出|で}ている。
examples.english: A high wave warning has been issued.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{波浪|はろう}が{高|たか}くなっている。
examples.english: The waves are high due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう}が{発令|はつれい}されたため、{漁船|ぎょせん}は{出港|しゅっこう}を{見合|みあ}わせた。
examples.english: Because a wave advisory was issued, the fishing boats postponed their departure.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in weather reports as {波浪警報|はろうけいほう} (high wave warning) or {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう} (wave advisory). In everyday speech, {波|なみ} (waves) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波浪警報|はろうけいほう} (high wave warning)
- {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう} (wave advisory)
- {波浪|はろう}が{高|たか}い (waves are high)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {波|なみ}: waves — general everyday term
- {高波|たかなみ}: high waves — more accessible than {波浪|はろう}
